_meta.indication: XENPOZYME is indicated for treatment of non-central nervous system manifestations of acid sphingomyelinase deficiency (ASMD) in adult and pediatric patients.

pivotal_trials.phase: Pivotal adequate and well-controlled trial (adult study)
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in adults
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with ASMD type B
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Two primary endpoints: % change in % predicted DLco from baseline to Week 52, and % change in spleen volume (MN) combined with change in splenomegaly related score (SRS) from baseline to Week 52
pivotal_trials.n: 31 evaluated in primary analysis (13 olipudase alfa, 18 placebo); 36 randomized
pivotal_trials.result: DLco: at Week 52 percentage increase from baseline 3.08% (placebo) vs 24.2% (olipudase alfa); LSM difference 21.1%, p<0.0001. Spleen volume: percentage decrease difference of 39.2% (CI 33.7, 44.7; p<0.0001).

key_safety: Most frequent adverse reactions in adults (≥10%) were headache, cough, diarrhea, hypotension, and ocular hyperemia; in pediatric patients (≥20%) pyrexia, cough, diarrhea, rhinitis, abdominal pain, vomiting, headache, urticaria, and others. Serious anaphylactic reactions were reported in 2 (25%) pediatric patients. Boxed warning is for severe hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis.
target_moa: Olipudase alfa is a recombinant human acid sphingomyelinase (ASM), a hydrolytic lysosomal sphingomyelin-specific enzyme, that acts as enzyme replacement therapy in ASMD, degrading sphingomyelin to ceramide and phosphocholine to reduce pathologic sphingomyelin accumulation.
modality: Enzyme (recombinant human acid sphingomyelinase enzyme replacement therapy)

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: SEVERE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS — Patients treated with XENPOZYME have experienced hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis. If a severe hypersensitivity reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) occurs, XENPOZYME should be discontinued immediately and appropriate medical treatment should be initiated.

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee was not held for this application; it did not raise challenging efficacy or safety issues that needed external input.
